title: Immich photo sync stale (no successful run in 6h)

annotations.description: The Mac Studio launchd sync (osxphotos export → immich-cli upload) heartbeats `started`/`idle`/`uploaded` events to Loki on every invocation. With WatchPaths + an hourly StartInterval safety net we expect >=6 successful events per 6 hours. Zero events for 6h means launchd is unloaded, the script is broken, the Mac Studio is offline, or Loki ingest is failing. Check `launchctl list | grep immich-photo-sync`, `~/immich-sync.log`, and Tailscale connectivity to logs:3100. Dashboard: /d/immich-sync/immich-photo-sync
annotations.summary: Immich photo sync stale: zero successful runs in 6 hours
